title: JFK wanted to declassify UFO files before his death

tellings.quote: John Kennedy declared he wanted to declassify some secret files concerning aliens and UFOs.

plain: President John F. Kennedy is said to have declared, before his death in 1963, that he wanted to declassify some secret files about aliens and UFOs. Kiran Ilum Xenov, the former president of a Russian republic who says he was himself taken by aliens, tells this as something Kennedy declared, without naming where it was recorded. If true, it would mean a sitting US president meant to reveal the government's UFO secrets.
